The threat is not somebody taking power from within the community. The threat is another force, even a nation state, coming in and deciding to take things over. The first thing a sovereign nation (or group of individuals if the connotation bothers some people) needs is a military capable of preventing a substantial force from simply coming in and taking whatever they please, or even declaring themselves ruler. Without that, that nation isn't going to be sovereign for long. And that military that costs an inordinate amount of money to fund. And it's made up primarily of people who are there because of extensive and organized propaganda efforts making sure the ranks stay full.

And voluntary systems of taxation simply will not work. Large scale donation systems suffer from a sort of tragedy of the commons. Nobody thinks their small contributing will matter, so they don't donate, so the entire system collapses. Voat is a perfect example of this. This site is of high value to many people that use it. And if those people all just donated $1 per month, the site would be overflowing with cash and there's a good chance Atko/Putts would be millionaires by now. Instead, the site regularly reaches the point of imminent closure for lack of funds. When there's a big push (hey look there's an earth quake, hey help the site is about to shut down, etc) it can provide revenue, but in the longterm that revenue approaches $0 without another big push - but the big pushes can't be too regular or they'll lose their impact.
